checks.title: Confirm renewal goal and authority
checks.instructions: Name Customer Success health owner and renewal decision owner, first read-only result, excluded customer contact and contract or billing actions.

checks.title: Bind exact account and legal entity
checks.instructions: Record tenant, customer account, legal entity, contract, subscription, owner, observation cutoff and stable renewal case key.

checks.title: Verify executed renewal and notice terms
checks.instructions: Read exact agreement revision, auto-renewal rule, renewal date, calendar-day notice period/timezone and prior notice source. Other notice rules require a reviewed manual calculation and remain needs_terms in this route. Do not infer renewal from date passage.

checks.title: Agree on bounded health evidence
checks.instructions: Set usage, first-value, support and relationship window, source coverage, signal definitions and observed-versus-hypothesis rules. No automatic churn score.

checks.title: Bind Health and Renewal capabilities
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Customer Health Coordinator and Renewal Coordinator skills, owners and access. Reuse one Crew when compatible or propose reviewed separate Crews.

checks.title: Probe current sources
checks.instructions: Read one exact account signal, executed agreement and current subscription/billing record or authorized exports. Record IDs, timestamps, access gaps and conflicting terms.

checks.title: Validate health and renewal artifacts
checks.instructions: Insert blocking validator steps before handoff and dashboard. Show wrong-account, unknown-health, changed contract and false renewal/action cases stop or remain pending.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source map, validator steps, notice calculation, owner decision, stable case key, manual route, optional event policy, cost and notifications.

checks.title: Run one real account manually
checks.instructions: Save current authorized source reads, artifacts, validation, owner correction or decision and unknown/missing-terms control. Fictional examples do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. A schedule or contract event needs authenticated identity, re-read, notice dedupe, changed-revision handling, cost, owner notification and explicit activation.
